responsibility: Implements predicate logic used to model context-sensitive function properties for inlining and specialization. It manages condition creation, clause insertion, conjunction/disjunction, remapping after duplication or inlining, evaluation/probability handling, and LTO streaming for ipa_predicate objects that encode when code, costs, or simplifications apply based on known argument values and parameter-derived conditions. This is the predicate algebra engine backing ipa-fnsummary and IPA-CP heuristics.
same_name_distinction: Implements the predicate machinery declared in ipa-predicate.h: the executable logic for clause insertion/normalization, predicate combination and remapping after duplication or inlining, plus LTO stream_in/stream_out and add_condition construction of summary conditions.
